args.subject: Re: LuminaAI Executive BI Dashboard - Sync Request
args.body:
Hi Kenji,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the sync for the Executive Business Intelligence Dashboard.

Unfortunately, I cannot make it this Friday (Nov 13) at 11 AM. Fridays are designated as my strict focus days for deep work and creative sprints, so I do not schedule any client meetings during that time block to ensure uninterrupted progress on all active projects.

I would love to find a time that works better for you on the other weekdays. I am available for syncs in the afternoon between 13:30 and 17:00 on Monday through Thursday. Please let me know which of these times work best for your schedule:

- Wednesday, Nov 18 @ 14:00 (2-hour slot)
- Thursday, Nov 19 @ 15:00 (2-hour slot)
- Tuesday, Nov 17 @ 16:00 (2-hour slot)

I look forward to finalizing the wireframe review with you.

Best regards,
Elena
